pull_request.title: Calorimeter: compare LAr and Si-W raw resolution versus eta and phi
pull_request.head: codex/ecal-raw-angular-restored
pull_request.body:
Shows the requested side-by-side raw energy-resolution plots with **15 bins per panel, LAr solid and Si–W dotted**. The φ panel uses the central **±15% of the 22.5° Si–W sector width** (±3.375°), pooling equivalent sectors. The user confirmed percent rather than degrees.

![Raw energy resolution](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/ecal-raw-angular-restored/docs/validation/ecal-raw-angular/figures/raw-energy-resolution.png?raw=true)

The signed-η panel retains all 10,000 matched electrons and its bin values are exactly unchanged. The φ panel uses **3,009 matched events per model**, retaining all zeros/tails within the specified directional window; 6,991 fall outside. The same signed Si–W sector phase is applied to both models, without reflection or an LAr-symmetry claim.

Uses the selected restored 1.8 mm Pb LAr baseline and staggered Si–W comparator. Width = sample SD(Eraw/Etrue)/mean(Eraw/Etrue), averaged over 10–80 GeV in ECAL-only B=0 transport. Pointwise 95% intervals use 1,000 shared whole-event bootstraps. PDF/SVG/PNG, bin counts/means/widths/zeros, full 60-variable covariance, source/render hashes and exact reproduction commands are retained. No new transport, calibration or geometry change. Original full-φ evidence is preserved at commit 3f270c4fc14b2689ebe5bbf67c1c474fc15f3993.

Validation: frozen sample/geometry/receipt/readback identities pass; independent degree-based nearest-sector folding and standard-library statistics match all 30 updated φ-bin means/SDs/widths/counts/zeros; η bins exactly match the original. Covariance finite/symmetric/positive semidefinite. Seven selection/statistics/identity tests pass; inventory, 302-session validation and PR interaction checks pass; PNG visually inspected; staged whitespace checked. Exact current-turn usage is unavailable.

Targets codex/restored-lar-em-baseline because the selected baseline stack is not on main yet. Related DES-032/033 and PR150. Draft under the standing human publication instruction in AGENTS.md (2026-11-06); no sign-off, ready-for-review action or merge.
